fix(round): run rounds only for open campaigns (#200)

Closing a campaign only stopped its weights. The watcher's queue query,
round creation and the round worker's claim ignored campaigns.status, so a
closed campaign kept getting rounds. On a static host serving another
campaign's GPUs each one voided on hardware mismatch and requeued its
challengers, which earned the next round.

Queue, create (under the campaign row lock) and claim now require
status = 'open'. A closed campaign's queued submissions and pending round
stay as they are and resume if it reopens.

Treat a miner's OpenRouter credit 402 as an exhausted run key (#374)

Simulator, Reader and decisions calls run on the miner's key. A 402 for
"Insufficient credits" or "requires more credits" comes from the miner's
own account, but only the 403 key-limit response stopped the run. The
Reader's judge turned the 402 into "configured reader failed", which was
recorded as environment_error, so the run failed as infrastructure and
was re-queued onto the same empty account.

Both 402s now count as key exhaustion: the run stops and is scored on its
finished episodes, as it is for the key limit. The in-flight reservation
402 clears as other calls finish and is unchanged.
